info.title: Syncfusion .NET CLI
info.description: Syncfusion .NET CLI provides commands to scaffold, configure, and manage Syncfusion applications across .NET platforms including MAUI, Blazor, WPF, WinForms, and WinUI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Syncfusion .NET CLI - create and manage MAUI and Windows desktop projects.
